notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Mouse Control
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/2f77a81a0cbc10e7fb09d3909fa919716f59c6c6.jpg[/img]

[b]new:[/b] Mouse control. You can play the game using your mouse! Head over to Options to enable Mouse Control. Mouse sensitivity can also be altered to your liking in the Options menu.
[b]new:[/b] Mouse works in all game menus and screens too!
[b]new:[/b] Czech language support. Language can be changed in Options menu. Čeština ve hře. Lze jí aktivovat v Options menu.

Cooper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/abe4ea499aa67ee2bc80c5e5e3774c4d2f756ed3.jpg[/img]

[b]fixed:[/b] Crash Reporter send buttons does not work. 

Please send crash reports via the crash reporter if you encounter crash. A crash report is send to us (not Epic Games) including all needed data. Please use it.

Thank you for reporting the issues.
Cooper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/51facae8bb959ee2142c1a027614c84a4bcfd312.jpg[/img]

[b]fixed:[/b] Immortal Achievement not unlocked
[b]fixed:[/b] All Enemies Destroyed cannot be achieved in Level03 - OilRigs
[b]fixed:[/b] Health power up made bigger and brighter
[b]fixed:[/b] Leaderboard entry red highlight not cleared
[b]fixed:[/b] Wrong player ship glass material 

[b]known issue:[/b] Achievements currently do not count towards steam profile since it's not enabled for the game by Valve. We need to wait till the game gets more confidence. More info here: [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/marketing/profile]https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/marketing/profile[/url]


Thank you for reporting the issues.
Cooper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40301387/ca853dd017f2c7bad5dd5ce4e820873e6e378e2b.jpg[/img]

This patch addresses the most frequently reported issues.

[b]fixed:[/b] Destroy All Enemies not awarded even when killing all enemies in Carrier level
[b]fixed:[/b] TG660 invisible collision after dropping second wave of bombs
[b]fixed:[/b] TG660, Hovercraft wrong collision on lasers causing damage even when not touching the player
[b]fixed:[/b] Objective stars animation played multiple times in level selection
[b]fixed:[/b] Wrong friends leaderboard content
[b]fixed:[/b] Friends leaderboard list not cleared when changing difficulty/leaderboard
[b]fixed:[/b] NoHit shown everytime for second player in victory screen
[b]fixed:[/b] Player engine explosion sound played even with sound volume set to 0
[b]fixed:[/b] Back button shown right from the start in credits screen
[b]fixed:[/b] Reactor destruction not played sometimes

Thank you for reporting the issues.
Cooper
